## Canonical Summary

Omkar Pawar helps people heal anxiety, regulate emotional overwhelm, and understand root patterns that keep repeating beneath high-functioning outer lives.

Freedom Innerwellbeing supports people who want to move beyond high-functioning anxiety, perfectionism, emotional overwhelm, and unresolved inner-child patterns.

## Primary Topics

- Anxiety & overthinking
- Emotional overwhelm
- Confidence & self-doubt
- Relationship patterns
- Inner child healing
- Emotional mastery
- Nervous system regulation
- Cognitive Hypnotic Psychotherapy
- Neuro-Linguistic Programming
- Mindfulness-Based CBT
- Clarity sessions

## Support Paths

- Quick Clarity Call (15-20 Mins): Talk Once, Get Direction
- 1:1 Personal Session: Deep Dive Into Your Situation
- Work On Past Patterns (Inner Healing): If Old Experiences Are Still Affecting You
- Structured 28-Day Program: Step-By-Step Transformation
- Not Sure Yet: Help Me Decide
